content.label:
Found my soulmate wellness app! Gentler Streak actually gets what it means to be human.
It doesn't give me a red 'X' or break my multi-day streak because I'm tired and need rest. Instead, it says: "Rest is part of the plan. See you tomorrow!"
It uses a beautiful, rolling "mountain path" to visualize my activity cycle, showing me clearly that active peaks and restful valleys together paint the complete picture of my health. Both are respected.
In a wellness tech space that often worships "no days off" and can feel like self-shaming, Gentler Streak offers a precious permission slip—to fluctuate, to listen to my body, and to pursue well-being without self-judgment.
If you're also tired of being held hostage by numbers and want a more flexible, kinder way to accompany yourself, you must try this. Health isn't a boot camp for your body; it's a journey you take with your body. Thank you, Gentler Streak, for finally putting me on that path. 🧡

I’ve used Gentler Streak for six months, and I honestly love it. I’m someone who always wants to be more active, but it’s really hard to set strict workout goals and keep up with them. This app doesn’t pressure you. It gives gentle reminders and encouragement, and it keeps reminding you that you don’t have to be strict with your body. I’d recommend it to anyone, especially women who want an active lifestyle without being pushed too hard. It’s perfect for long-term use.
I’m a “senior citizen” who likes to keep active and love the way this app can accommodate my activity - mainly walking.  It is encouraging and when I need a nudge - it is gentle!  Thanks much!
Gentler Streak has been such a great way for me to evaluate my progress and maintain a healthy lifestyle. I appreciate how easy it is to use and understand.

I am a recent retiree who is loving the time/ability to be active. Whether it be active travel, pickleball, or a fitness class - they bring me joy, social connection, and help me maintain my health. I am not looking to become an Olympic athlete (obviously). A key concern for me is to keep my activity level and intensity balanced and safe so it remains sustainable. Gentler Streak echos and enables that philosophy perfectly. Thrilled to have found it!

title.label: Best way to realistically stay active

content.label: I use my Apple Watch to track workouts and all, and filling the rings in Fitness is fun, but it is terribly unrealistic to fill them every single day. Gentler Streak’s path feature truly helps to keep me on track by letting me evaluate overall fitness, not just for today. It not only gently nudges when my activity is too low, but also provides a reminder when I’m pushing too much. The weekly, monthly, and overviews help me to visualize the bigger picture, too. All of this is way more motivating.

I really like that this app accounts for life and fitness levels.  I didn’t find the free option helpful and the help information seems to be written from the perspective of the paid app. I did upgrade, but I think the information should cover both unpaid and paid. Until I upgraded, my “path “ didn’t show anything like what was in the help. Still, really enjoying the (paid version) app.

This has proven to be an excellent app with great insight into the current state of my health and trajectory over time. My favorite feature by far is the active monitoring and warnings when I’m pushing too far. Without it or when I ignore it, I definitely feel worse off the next day, but when I respect it I feel like I’ve made solid progress and still feel well in the coming days.
Está es una de las mejores aplicaciones para seguimiento no solo por la data sino por como la muestra la verdad es oasis de conocimientos de datos duros contrastados con la realidad del día a día
I appreciate the feedback I get from Gentler Streak. Between time at the gym and an active life I get a good sense of where my fitness level is at and where I need to focus.

This app is great. It looks great. The user interface is great. The information is great. I look at it literally every day. I really enjoy being able to review my sleep and the insights and see how my exercise routines and my sleep affect my overall health. The recommendations helped me to push myself without going too far.

title.label: Great app but comparison to food needs work

content.label:
I truly appreciate everything this app does and how it encourages me to be the best I can be without making me feel awful for already being perfect. 
The only thing that gives me pause is the fact that every workout and weekly/monthly summary puts calories burned into the concept of food. I think the idea behind this came from a good place, most people don’t understand what “100 calories” truly is, but this could be dangerous for people with eating disorders, as the app almost implies “you can have an apple now that you worked out”

I really do love using Gentler Streak. It’s encouraged me to stay within a band of activity rather than the default rings, such that I don’t feel bad for missing a day or something. It feels like a more healthy reminder for long term trends than daily engagement. The UI is pleasant to use. I really like that the data is all stored locally in Apple Health too such that if I ever did stop using it, I still have all the history, plus I know it’s just staying local.

title.label: One of my most used apps!

content.label: I tend to go at things hard. Push it to the wall hard. Invariably I ended up either sick or injured. This app really helps me to progress without breaking myself. I can see when I need to rein it in AND when I can push to make optimal progress. Rest days used to be so hard for me. Now I take one of the suggestions for an active rest day - whether full rest or gentle exercise that will help me recover faster from the hard stuff. I also love the sleep and vital signs info. And.. the articles are short, science based and informative. Love this app!

Context: 68 yrs female. 
Never been motivated to achieve goals or do competitive activities. I am constantly managing the possibility of inducing a migraine after exercise. 
Go Gentler has been my coach while I navigate staying fit. Coupling the app with Apple’s Health Tracker has been so helpful to assess my ups and downs, catch early issues, and to stay positive about the aging process. Thank you.
Well polished with great information.
The best app for my age and fitness level.  So much encouragement and non judgmental advice.  Thank you!!!
I love the holistic approach to working out. It allows me to better understand my body and what it needs each day.

title.label: Perfect for those with chronic conditions

content.label:
I have fibromyalgia and severe chronic migraines that for years have left me in a constant loop of over doing it and then crashing. When I got my Apple Watch a few years ago I found this app and began using it and it has helped me finally gain strength and stamina despite my conditions. When I listen to the app and follow my “path” then I do so well. Any time I ignore it and go beyond it then I suffer and crash. I use the app daily to monitor my sleep  and I feel it very accurately reflects my strength. It also catches my illnesses (viruses and what not). The apple health app will tell me I had great sleep even if i didn’t but the Gentler Streak app will reflect reality. It even could tell when I was unwell from grief when my health app was saying I was doing great. I highly highly recommend this app to everyone, especially those who suffer from chronic conditions and need help pacing to avoid injury and over extending oneself. 

Thank you Gentler Streak for helping me get my life back.
I have tried several apps to monitor my sleep. This is the only one that seems complete and helpful.

title.label: Been using for a few years

content.label: It’s a great way to visualize your wellness journey. I like that it is interesting and well thought out. I don’t use the workouts or anything like that but I really don’t like how clinical the raw Apple health diagrams are so this gives me a better way to see everything. Highly recommend.
I use this app every day to guide my exercise program and determine the level of effort I’ll put into it.  Gentler Streak guides me effortlessly and keeps me in good shape without harming my body!

I’m not a competitive athlete. I’m an old fart and just want an app to help me stay healthy as long as possible. GS helps me stay motivated by tracking a few personal health and exercise metrics. I’ve tried a bunch of the heavy hitters, but most of them are all about social media or flooded with ads. Gentler Streak is just about perfect for me. It tracks my bike rides, walks and stretching, yoga and strength training, encourages me when I’ve been lazy for too long and even yells at me when I overdo it. I only wish it would read a few other metrics from Apple Health and display them along with the ones built into the ‘wellbeing’ tab, but I guess if they did that for everybody the app would end up being a bloated mess. Still, 95% perfect and (though I despise suckscriptions) Gentler Streak is one of the few I’ll willingly pay.

** edit ** And congratulations on being recognized by Apple as a 2024 Design Award winner!

title.label: App has been amazing for keeping me in top form

content.label: I often get ahead of myself and overdo it. This app really helps me stay where I need to be, to perform at my best!

I’ve used Gentler Streak for five months now. I’ve lost 31lbs adhering to my activity path and a good diet. Gentler Streak takes vital information about my physical health and turns it into a manageable daily approach to regular exercise. Will be renewing my subscription when the current one expires.

I’ve used a lot of exercise tracking apps in the past. Most, I use for a week or two. Most are overcomplicated and focused on the wrong things. Most are not for people like me, who run and lift, but aren’t tracking glucose intake and protein macros.

This app I have had for two years. In that time it has gained features and remained the cleanest app on the store (I am jealous of the programming skill). It has also helped motivate me, been forgiving, and it has never made me feel like I can’t keep up or that hiatuses have ended my fitness path. It just picks up with me and provides a simple mechanism for me to motivate to keep going. As such, it’s been with me for paintball, running, biking, weight lifting, it helps me see how I’m sleeping, gives me fun stats on how badly my body regulates temperature at night when I’m sick, and just keeps things calm, positive, and forward moving.

I have a lot of respect for these developers. They are thoughtful and responsive, they are talented and creative, and they’ve made an app (which even Apple’s attempts to absorb their feature set) cannot be beaten. Yohart forever!

The only app that actually keeps me going with my fitness. I really compete with myself when the line starts dipping! Also, you can really feel the care behind the project from the team that built this. ❤️ Thank you!!

I use Gentler Streak every day, from checking my sleep and daily health measures, to work outs and advice. I love the real world options for exercise (like gardening, shoveling snow) and the “care for yourself” approach, knowing that people need rest, a break, get sick, etc. Integrates seamlessly into the Apple Health ecosystem as well. I am healthier for using this app, how often can you say that?

title.label: Fantastic for building good, healthy habits

content.label: The app’s ability to provide encouragement and data to back it up is great, but for my personality, the more important things are when it notices me pushing too hard, or when I’m not at my best. It encourages me to moderate my activity, to take breaks, so that I don’t burn myself out or injure myself. Something I’ve done with other trackers.
I love Gentler Streak! I check this App every day and find encouragement, humor and empathy. If being healthy is a full-time job, Gentler Streak is my fave work colleague!
Great app!  Easy to use and allows for modifications between vacations, sickness…Love it!!

As a heart survivor, I don't need "hustle" culture or apps that try to sell me extra hardware I don't need. I need clarity and kindness. Gentler Streak is the only app I’ve found that actually listens to my body. It integrates perfectly with my existing health ecosystem (Apple Health/Withings) and gives me actionable advice without the corporate "noise." It’s rare to find a team that prioritizes the user over data-selling or investor pressure. Highly recommended for anyone who needs a realistic, health-first approach to movement.
Well done gentler streak team. One suggestion I have is a watch complication for steps. It is a metric on the dashboard but it would be nice to see the progress throughout the day.

title.label: Life changing and I'm not being dramatic.

content.label: This app truly helped me get my fitness and health back in order. I appreciate the gentle approach and the suggestions. The communication especially from Yorhart is what motivates me.

title.label: Get it, you won’t regret it.

content.label: I love this app.  It’s super easy to use, great for helping me find ways to fit fitness into my life, and I appreciate the approach that there is such a thing as too much working out. I also LOVE how the app makes it okay to take a break if you’re sick or injured.  I love that it integrates with my Apple Watch. Please keep on doing a good job!
It does a great job of motivating me while keeping me from overtraining. Absolutely love that all the data is local. Should be how all apps are.

Gentler Streak is a terrific and simple app for visualizing workouts, load and progress. I happily pay for the subscription because it’s a nice, powerful and well-maintained app, and the team behind it seems to genuinely enjoy creating and improving Gentler Streak.

This app has been a lifesaver for me. It encourages me to improve my fitness without stressing me out that I’m not doing enough like my Apple Fitness app used to do. They care about your privacy, too, and none of your data is stored anywhere but your phone. Highly recommend!

title.label: Gentler Streak has genuinely changed my life

content.label:
Living with chronic illness means constantly walking a line between doing too much and doing too little. Most fitness apps don’t understand that line at all. Gentler Streak does. 

After using the app for over 2 years, I feel supported instead of judged.

This app helped me reconnect with my body in a way that feels compassionate, realistic, and sustainable. Instead of pushing me toward arbitrary goals or streaks that ignore my limits, Gentler Streak helps me listen—to my energy, my pain levels, my recovery needs, and my capacity on any given day. That alone has been life-changing.

What I appreciate most is how validating the experience feels. Rest days aren’t framed as failure. Low-energy days aren’t treated as something to “fix. Progress is about doing what’s right for your body. As someone with chronic illness, that mindset shift has reduced so much guilt, anxiety, and self-blame around movement.

Gentler Streak has helped me build trust with my body again. It’s made movement feel safer, more intuitive, and more possible over time. I honestly can’t imagine navigating my health without it now. Thank you for creating an app that truly sees people like me. 💛

I love the app. The gentle push towards wellness and caring for yourself is much needed. I love that the team and the app focus on not over exerting yourself constantly and prioritize rest and recovery. It doesn’t make you feel like a failure if you haven’t been able to work out due to injury or illness. That is life! And the Gentle Streaks team gets it. Thank you!

title.label: Great Workout app that fits my life

content.label: Being over 70 years old, I didn’t really connect well with most fitness apps. Gentler Streak really works well for me. It encourages exercise but also lets me know if I’m overreaching and then suggests to take a day off!  This is one of the few apps that I am happy to pay for.

I love how Gentler Streak combines a refined and  elegant UI and gamification without being pushy or annoying. It’s subtle so I don’t necessarily use it every day but when I do, I enjoy it and want to come back. It feels encouraging - not shame-based, and is a delight to use. I’ve been exercising a LOT more since downloading it.

Gentler Streak is one of my favorite tools for managing my fibromyalgia. It helps me stop before I do too much, know when to rest and when I can push a bit, and doesn’t make me feel like I’m not doing enough. Love you guys!! 💜

I was very athletic until chronic illness inhibited my ability to push limits. All of the apps I’d been using were quick to point out how far I’d fallen; none in positive or kind manner. Gentler Streak is different.   It sees me for who I am today. It allows me to note if I’m injured or ill, and recreates baselines as I recover. If my heart rate is running high, or I didn’t get enough sleep, it goes with the flow and encourages recovery instead of pushing. It truly is a gentler way to both track and receive guidance.

i enjoy this app. My goal is not to look like a bodybuilder. My goal is simply to increase my activity. I'm an all or nothing person. This app has helped me do my best every day and not made me feel bad on days where I am not capable of strong effort. It is nice to look at the app and have it tell me it's OK to have a recovery day. I highly recommend this app.

I appreciate this app tracking my dog walks, gardening, snow shovelling & housework. I live in a house with many stairs; but my smart watch was not really tracking what I actually did. Now I have a better record of my actual activity so that I know when I need to step it up.

Been using this app for years now and absolutely love it. The team is constantly pushing out new (useful, accurate) features. It works darn near flawlessly with my Apple Watch and plays nice with Peloton and other fitness/wellness apps I use. 

Recommend this app to anyone who loves data and wants to be active!
I’ve tried a bunch of suggest exercise apps but this is the only one I’ve stuck with. The perfect blend of aesthetics and functionality. With extra charm thrown in too.

I use GS with Apple Watch every day to check on my sleep heart rate, sleep quality, and my training “path”. It’s been very consistent in showing me if I’m doing too little or too much and whether I need to take it easy (high sleep hr). Loving it!
I use this with my Apple One bundle so the whole family can use it. Highly recommended to keep everyone on track and motivated. I also use Bevel Health with my Garmin watch too. Love it!
